title: Hundred Days (1815)
key_facts: Napoleon’s final campaign after returning from exile
Rapid French offensive through Belgium and into the Netherlands
Decisive battles: Ligny, Quatre Bras, and Waterloo
Ended with Napoleon’s defeat, abdication, and second exile
causes: Napoleon’s return from Elba during the Congress of Vienna
Seventh Coalition’s determination to defeat Napoleon permanently
French exhaustion after years of war and coalition unity
outcome: Second Bourbon Restoration under Louis XVIII
Congress of Vienna settlement and European balance of power

figures.name: Napoleon Bonaparte
figures.role: Emperor of the French; final campaign commander

impacts: Ended the Napoleonic Wars and Napoleonic era
Redrew European map and confirmed conservative dominance
Set stage for the Concert of Europe and 19th‑century diplomacy
